figures.caption: Design, screening, and antimicrobial activity of AMPs obtained from traversal design and machine learning. a, Flow chart of AMP design. b, c, Confusion matrix and ROC curve of machine learning model (WeightedEnsemble_L3; ROC-AUC = 0.87; accuracy = 72 %). d, MIC of AMPs against gram-positive bacteria (S. aureus ATCC25923 (Sa), S. aureus USA300 (MRSA), and E. faecalis ATCC29212, B. subtilis ATCC6633) and gram-positive bacteria (E. coli ATCC25922, P. aeruginosa ATCC15442, A. baumannii ATCC19606). figures.caption: Biocompatibility and efficacy of P1P18 and P18E6 in vivo. a, b, Changes in body weight and relative organ wight of C57BL/6 mice administration of P1P18 and P18E6 (0, 10, 20, or 40 mg/kg). c, Renal and liver function-related indexes of mice following administration of HAMPs for 5 d. d, e, Histopathological morphology analysis of the liver (d) and kidney (e) in mice following administration of 40 mg/kg HAMPs for 5 days.
